 Petrol price cut by Rs6.59, diesel by Rs4.25 per litre
 Top Story 
 By  Our Correspondent 
 November 07, 2026 
 A petrol station attendant prepares to refuel a car in Rome, Italy, January 4, 2012. — Reuters  ISLAMABAD: The government has cut petrol prices by Rs6.59 and diesel by Rs4.25 per litre for four days starting Saturday, offering consumers fresh relief at the pumps, the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Ogra) announced Friday.
 Under the revised prices, petrol will cost Rs346 per litre, down from Rs352.59, while high-speed diesel will be available at Rs378 per litre, compared with Rs382.25 previously.
 The new prices will take effect on Nov. 7 and remain unchanged until Nov. 10 because of a public holiday on Nov. 9, Ogra said in a press release.
 The latest reduction follows the government’s review of petroleum product prices under the approved pricing mechanism. Petrol and diesel prices are closely watched in Pakistan because of their direct impact on transportation costs, inflation and the prices of essential commodities.
